lane.description: Without a lane every lane stops.

get.description: All chats, most recently active first.

delete.description: Stops running answers of the chat first.

patch.description: A new title is the user's and is never replaced automatically.

post.description:
Asks a question and streams the answer. Without an API key the stream carries the
sources only (`done.status = sources_only`).

200.description: Events `meta`, `status`, `sources`, `delta`, `citation`, then exactly one `done` or `error` (payloads: Sse* schemas). A `: ping` comment every 15 s.

post.description: Replaces an answer to the latest question (same lane, same message id).

200.description: Events `meta`, `status`, `sources`, `delta`, `citation`, then exactly one `done` or `error` (payloads: Sse* schemas). A `: ping` comment every 15 s.

post.description:
Second safety net next to aborting the request: stops the lane's answer, which is then
saved as `stopped`.

get.description:
Loaded at start. The UI loads it again when an answer reveals a change: a rejected key
(`llm_status`), a model Claude does not know (`available`), the budget.
All documents, newest first. Poll while any is not `ready` or `failed`.

post.description: Raw body, one file per request. Answers 202 at once; ingestion runs in the background.

delete.description: Allowed in every status; stops a running ingestion.

get.description: One chunk with its sentences and line rectangles, for highlighting a citation.
The original file with safe headers. Supports Range requests (PDF viewer).

206.description: Partial content for a Range request.

get.description: TXT/MD as the decoded, normalized text that sentence offsets refer to (text viewer).
No dependencies. Electron uses `app` to verify it talks to this application.
Ready means search works. A missing API key does not block readiness.
